narr: A low pressure center was parked over the northern half of Indiana throughout much of the day on the 17th, with points to the south, including KY, exhibiting a warming and moistening trend throughout the day. Scattered showers and storms were present across Kentucky and surrounding areas throughout the afternoon and evening. A couple of these storms ended up resulting in several downed trees. Multiple rounds of heavy rain moved across portions of Pike County, leading to a flash flood near the community of Mouthcard.
ev: The Fedscreek Co-op observer reported that water was flowing over the road along Big Card Road near the junction with Hwy-460.
lsr: FEDSCREEK CO-OP OBSERVER REPORTED WATER FLOWING OVER THE ROAD ALONG BIG CARD RD NEAR THE JUNCTION WITH US-460. TIME ESTIMATED.
